bugs.root_cause: Three-piece chain: (1) Phase 14a/b probe jitter (8-position Halton × 2 hold-frames) cycles probe positions every 2 frames; (2) pre-existing `fresh α only` policy in both temporal EMA paths (fused in radiance_3d.comp:600 and fallback in temporal_blend.comp:90) overwrites blended α with current frame's α; (3) Phase 2 raymarch.frag sampleProbeDir does `w = wcos * a.a`, so display directly multiplies by per-frame fresh α. Net: per-bin α flips 0↔1 frame-to-frame as jitter shifts probes; display weighting flickers; RGB is EMA-smoothed but α-gating undoes the smoothing. Measured: consecutive-frame RMSE 0.013, 22% pixels changed.

Trade-off accepted: α drifts from Phase 2's binary {0,1} to a soft time-average of per-bin visibility — more info, but breaks any code asserting α ∈ {0,1}. Bake-leak metric (counts α<0.001 bins) still works as a soft threshold; numbers shift slightly (44925→44752 bins counted on default cornell-orig-alcove) but Phase 3 v1 effect (11% reduction OFF→ON) preserved. Verified consecutive-frame RMSE 0.013 → 0.0003 (40× reduction).

bugs.root_cause: PT compute-shader dispatch gate at line 1244 included only modes 16/18/19, not mode 20. When mode 20 is active the PT accumulators (uPtAccum, uPtDirectAccum) are never populated this frame and uPtAccumValid stays 0, so the shader uses ptTruth = vec3(0). Then delta = cascadeFull - 0 = cascadeFull → always positive → red. Sub-modes 1/2/3 fail the same way because they read uPtDirectAccum / uPtAccum without checking validity.

bugs.root_cause: noiseSeedOffset is wired ONLY into uMBFrameSeed (multi-bounce cascade resampling). It is NOT added to (a) ptFrameIndex → uFrameIndex in pt_reference.comp [demo3d.cpp:3267], or (b) hybridFrameSeed → uHybridFrameSeed in hybrid_correction.comp [demo3d.cpp:3618]. Result: PT ground truth is bit-identical across seed offsets, and the cascade primary sampling (non-MB) is also identical, so mode 18/19 deltas are bit-identical. The MB feedback IS reseeded but contributes too little to mode-18 luminance delta to register at 256-level PNG quantization. Doc comment in demo3d.h:1453-1457 already says 'Added to the cascade-bake RNG site (uMBFrameSeed) AND MB v2 stochastic sampler' — the AND was aspirational; only the cascade-bake site shipped.

bugs.root_cause: Measurement-camera mode pins probe jitter to zero (demo3d.cpp:962+977) for reproducibility. The per-frame cascadeReady=false invalidation only fires from jitter advance (line 974) or GUI/SDF/toggle changes. With jitter pinned and no GUI toggles in a headless run, cascadeReady becomes true after frame 0's bake and STAYS true. Phase MB requires per-frame rebakes to accumulate temporal feedback (the GUI tooltip even says 'each frame's bake includes previous frame's indirect'). Net: in measurement mode, MB feedback runs exactly once at frame 0 with historyNeedsSeed=true (so MB is gated OFF that frame anyway); frames 1..N skip the bake entirely. Result: multiBounceGain CLI parses fine, setter fires, gain reaches uniforms, but the shader never executes the gain*feedback path on any frame.
bugs.fix: Added 4-line conditional in render() at demo3d.cpp:986-994: 'if (measurementCamera >= 0 && useMultiBounce) cascadeReady = false;' This forces per-frame rebake when both measurement mode AND MB are active. Verified: post-fix md5(sanity_g100.png)=2fd0a272... vs md5(sanity_g200.png)=5118d014... (distinct). Cost: ~5-15s extra per 512-frame capture at scaled-D=8 cornell (bake ~10-30ms). Hybrid sweep mode does NOT need a parallel fix because hybrid dispatches every frame regardless of cascadeReady. PT-only modes also unaffected (they don't depend on MB).
